purpose: Qualify the bounded Ross face candidate for the half-cell surface-to-top-node geometry needed by the legacy SWAP flux/head top-boundary switch, without yet composing surface storage or runoff.
constitutive_scope: Staringreeks 2018 unimodal Mualem-van Genuchten, KSATFIT, H_ENPR=0, KSATEXM disabled

independent_holdout.dry_mapping: hsurf=a^4 in [0,1] cm; htop=-10^(4b) in [-10000,-1] cm
independent_holdout.near_mapping: hsurf=a^4 in [0,1] cm; htop=-b^4 in [-1,0] cm

reference: full-accuracy steady hydraulic face solve with physical face length explicitly set to 5 cm
candidate: existing bounded local/two-sided endpoint candidate with all length-dependent branch logic explicitly set to 5 cm

surface_head_scope_provenance.scope_rule: The first qualification is deliberately bounded to 0..1 cm. Larger allowed legacy PONDMX values are outside this gate and require separate qualification.

architecture_checks.6_scalable_memory_layout: No per-column table or face state is introduced.
architecture_checks.13_mass_conservation_absolute: This gate qualifies only an antisymmetric interface flux; full surface-ledger conservation remains a later gate.
architecture_checks.20_alternative_soil_water_solvers: Face geometry is explicit qualification input rather than a hidden Richards-only constant.
architecture_checks.23_physics_solver_policy_separated: Face length and surface head are physical/geometry inputs; bisection bounds are numerical policy.
architecture_checks.24_predictable_runtime: Candidate evaluation counts remain bounded by the frozen E2C cost caps.
architecture_checks.29_no_silent_dependencies: The 5 cm length is explicit and cannot inherit the existing 10 cm C1R assumption silently.

hard_nonclaims: No full top-boundary or ponding qualification.
No C1R 10 cm table reuse at 5 cm.
No surface heads above 1 cm qualified.
